plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 53 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.88415, -132.05893, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 330 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 7 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-12, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
